title: Security & Compliance review 1:1 - prep notes (2026-03-04)
content:
Quick personal prep notes for my 1:1 with Priya (security lead) and Maya (internal audit) - meeting scheduled 2026-03-05 10:00am PT. Goal: sync on audit readiness for upcoming SOC2 readiness review, outstanding evidence, vendor risk backlog, and next steps for ISO scoping.

Agenda (what I want to cover)
- 5m: quick status (what's done / biggest gaps)
- 15m: evidence review by control family (Access, Change Mgmt, Logging, Incident Response, Vendor Mgmt)
- 10m: vendor risk queue and outstanding vendor questionnaires + remediation timelines
- 10m: audit logistics (who's point for each evidence bucket, folder locations, timestamps)
- 10m: action items + deadlines + owners

Top-of-mind items (notes to self)
- We promised auditor access to 3 months of system logs; need to confirm rolling export to S3 (logs-retention-prod) - who owns export job? (Infra: Ryan)
- Change management evidence: need recent PR -> release linkage examples for last three deploys (rel-notes + changelog)
- Access control: list of privileged accounts + last access review - run AD / IdP report and drop into confluence page before meeting
- Vendor risk: vendor questionnaires still outstanding for ProviderX (payment processing) and DataStoreCo (backup vendor). ProviderX questionnaire partially complete; risk rating currently Medium. Need estimated remediation date from VendorOps.
- ISO scoping question: confirm whether Dedicated customers in EU require separate scope (data residency controls). Flag for product / legal if yes.

Evidence checklist (by control family) - quick status: (DONE / NEEDS / IN PROGRESS)
- Access Controls: user provisioning/ deprovisioning runbook (DONE), privileged account list (NEEDS), MFA enforcement report (IN PROGRESS)
- Change Management: deployment approval logs (IN PROGRESS), change-ticket -> PR traceability samples (NEEDS), emergency change postmortems (DONE)
- Logging & Monitoring: 90-day logs exported (NEEDS), alerting runbook (DONE), SLI/SLO dashboards (IN PROGRESS)
- Incident Response: incident playbook (DONE), most recent tabletop notes (NEEDS), on-call rotation evidence (DONE)
- Vendor Management: vendor inventory (IN PROGRESS), recent vendor risk assessments (NEEDS), contracts with security addenda (NEEDS)

Things to ask Priya/Maya during the 1:1
- Which control families auditors typically probe first during readiness review? (helps prioritize evidence uploads)
- For ProviderX, what is acceptable mitigation for missing questionnaire items - temporary compensating control vs require vendor remediation?
- How strict is the timeline auditors expect for resolving Medium/High vendor risks pre-audit?
- Any recent audit scope changes (ISO) that would force additional evidence collection for Dedicated deployments?

Quick links / where evidence should live (confirm during meeting)
- Confluence control matrix: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/SOC2+Control+Matrix
- Evidence S3 bucket: s3://redwood-security-evidence/prod/2026-q1
- Example PR->Release mapping: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/PR-release-mapping

Action items (assign and date)
- Ethan: Pull privileged account access report from IdP and upload to Confluence (due 2026-03-06)
- Ryan Kim (Infra): Confirm logs export job status and share runbook + S3 path (due 2026-03-05)
- Maya Thompson (Internal Audit): Prioritize control families for auditor queries and share checklist (due 2026-03-06)
notes_summary: Personal scratchpad for SOC2/ISO readiness 1:1. Covers agenda, evidence checklist, vendor risk, questions for security leads, and assigned action items.
